[LGRA.21.4] **Grammar scope.** The production above is the **full** `.dstest` surface — every
sub-production (`initial:` facts + cache seed, absolute coordinates, the
`emitted … where` predicate, `for call` argument match + `after
<dur>`, the `cached "k": v` value, and the `wm has <Schema> …` slot match) is
in the grammar, carried by the `Test*` / `Oracle*` atom fields ([RDSC.7.1]). `LTSL`
remains their normative home.
